intro1: This Return Policy (hereinafter - "Policy") defines the terms and procedure for refunding funds to Users for digital services provided by Global SIM LLC (OGRN 1257700534475, INN 9721260266 (hereinafter - "Contractor") through the website, mobile application and other digital interfaces under the JETSIM brand.
intro2: The Policy is an integral part of the JETSIM Public Offer and applies to all Users who have accepted the offer and paid for the Services.
section1_1_1: JETSIM provides information and organizational and other digital services that are not communication services. The service is considered properly provided from the moment the User is granted access to the functionality of the corresponding service (account activation, eSIM QR code display, instructions, opening of the management interface or other equivalent action).
section2_text1: Refund of funds is carried out depending on the grounds and the period of application:
section2_2_1: 2.1. Refund within the warranty period (technical refund):
section2_2_1_text: Allowed if the application was received within 30 calendar days from the date of payment for access to the eSIM profile (warranty period) and there are documented technical reasons beyond the User's control, as a result of which the use of the paid Service became impossible.
section2_list1_item1: technical failure or error of the JETSIM service that occurred due to the fault of the Contractor and led to the complete impossibility of using the Service;
section2_list1_item2: incorrect operation of eSIM on a compatible device;
section2_list1_item3: activation errors not related to the User's actions.
section2_2_2: 2.2. Refund in general order (before activation and on other grounds):
section2_list2_label: Refund is possible in the following cases:
section2_list2_item1: erroneous or double debiting of funds during payment;
section2_list2_item2: cancellation by the Contractor of the provision of the Service before its activation or first use by the User;
section2_list2_item3: User's refusal of the Service before activation of the eSIM profile - with deduction of the Contractor's actual expenses (payment commissions, order processing costs, etc.);
section2_list2_item4: other cases expressly provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
section2_list3_item1: access to the functionality was provided and the User started using the Service (eSIM profile is activated);
section2_list3_item2: technical problems arose due to reasons on the User's side (including incompatible device, network failure, configuration errors, blocks, access restrictions in the country of use);
section2_list3_item3: refusal of the Service is caused by personal reasons (loss of interest, expecting different quality, change of plans, etc.);
section2_list3_item4: the application was submitted after the expiration of the warranty period without grounds provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
section3_list1_item1: within the warranty period (30 calendar days from the date of payment) - for refunds related to technical reasons under clause 2.1;
section3_list1_item2: before activation of the eSIM profile, but not more than 30 calendar days from the date of payment - for refunds on the grounds specified in clause 2.2.
section3_3_2_text: To initiate a refund, the User sends a written application through the form on the website www.jetsim.ru or by e-mail support@jetsim.ru
section3_list2_label: The following documents are attached to the application:
section3_list2_item2: description of circumstances (date, type of violation, essence of the problem);
section3_list2_item3: if necessary - information about the device and/or identity document to confirm the payment ownership.
section3_3_3_text1: The Contractor reviews the application within 10 (ten) business days from the date of receipt of the complete set of information.
section3_3_3_text2: If necessary, additional data may be requested to verify technical reasons or the fact of activation.
section3_3_4_text1: If the request is satisfied, the refund is made in the same way as the payment was made, unless otherwise agreed with the User.
section3_3_4_text2: When refunding, the amount may be reduced by the Contractor's actual expenses related to the refund operation (banking and payment commissions), if their imposition on the User is not prohibited by law.
section3_3_5_text: The transfer is made within 10 (ten) banking days from the date of the refund decision, unless another period is established by law or payment system rules.
section4_4_1: JETSIM has the right to change this Policy. The new version is posted on the official website and comes into force from the moment of publication, unless another period is specified.
section4_4_2: Continued use of the Services after the publication of the new version means the User's consent to the changes.
section4_4_3: Legal regulation of issues related to the refund of funds is carried out in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation, including the Law of the Russian Federation "On Protection of Consumer Rights" and the Civil Code of the Russian Federation.
